text:
jules: Quick sync — thinking about a compact 'mini-query' affordance in the route view: a quick saved-query switcher that shows model, sample cost/latency hint, and a routing hint (preferred model/region). Want to converge on API shape + telemetry we need for rollout. :eyes:

sam: +1. API-wise we should avoid coupling saved-query objects to routing policy internals. Suggest an optional routing_hint blob instead of embedding policy ids.

maria: UX note: keep the compact UI uncluttered — only show a single-line badge for cost/latency and an icon if it has a routing hint. Clicking expands details. Mock microcopy: "Uses gpu-optimized variant — est. 12ms / 0.4c"

rishi: From platform: saved-query needs a small digest so the router can fallback deterministically (e.g., model_family + fallback_order). Also we should surface quota impact: per-route preview of token burn vs. global average. That implies server-side cost estimates.

sam: Sketch API: 
```json
{
  "id": "sq_...",
  "name": "High-throughput summary",
  "scope": "route",
  "model_selector": { "family": "mixtral", "preferred": "mixtral-12b-gpu" },
  "routing_hint": { "preferred_region": "us-west-2", "fallback_family": ["mixtral-8b"] },
  "preview_flags": { "show_cost": true, "cost_estimate_mode": "server" }
}
```

rishi: Two cautions: (1) server cost_estimate_mode requires joining telemetry + kernel-profile heuristics — estimates have lag and CI bounds; (2) storing preferred_region can create sticky routing that defeats autoscaling. Make preferred_region advisory only.

maria: UX compromise: show an "advisory" pill if the saved query has a routing hint. Tooltip: "Router may choose a compatible variant based on capacity". Keeps expectations aligned.

jules: Telemetry proposal: events we need — saved_query.apply, saved_query.preview_render, saved_query.routing_fallback_triggered (with fallback_reason), and cost_estimate_discrepancy.

sam: Add sampling: router emits routing_fallback_triggered at 1% by default, ramp during canary. Include saved_query.id and route.id in every event for correlation.

rishi: For quota previews include: estimated_tokens, estimated_cost_units, and boolean "uses_dedicated_capacity" so console can surface SLA hints. Important for Dedicated customers.

maria: Visual tweak: when estimated_tokens > threshold show a subtle "high-cost" warning with hover explaining changes. Prefer server-provided buckets.

sam: Implementation note: server-side cost estimates are expensive if per-model simulation. Start with stats-based heuristics (avg tokens per prompt-length bucket) and add an async profiling job later. API field can be cost_estimate_v1 with mode tag.

jules: Rollout plan: canary the API + console in phases: (A) read-only preview (1% users, badges + telemetry), (B) enable quick-apply switcher (10% canary) with opt-out. Gate by feature flag. rollout-bot: create canary flag.

rollout-bot: created feature flag feature/ui/mini-query-quickswitch/canary — default off. Canary toggle in console: product -> rollout flags.

jules: Action items: Sam — open API PR with the shape above + sampleRate field and cost_estimate_mode enum. Rishi — doc for server cost heuristics and advisory routing policy. Maria — mock for compact and expanded states. I'll draft telemetry event schema and a canary checklist.

sam: I'll have a PR draft by EOD with migration doc and an error contract when server estimate is unavailable.

rishi: I'll add an advisory vs sticky hints section and a server flag to mark hint as advisory.

maria: I'll drop two mock files in Figma and paste the link in the PR.

jules: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after PR review. :thumbsup:
